users.label: Users
users.description: Every account on this instance: the global role, whether the address is confirmed, and the dự án each user can reach.

teams.label: Teams
teams.description: Every team on this instance: the dự án it owns and who belongs to it.

projects.label: Dự án
projects.description: Every dự án on this instance: what each one holds, when it was last active, and who can reach it.

authentication.label: Authentication
authentication.description: Who may register on this instance, how accounts are confirmed, and the providers people đăng nhập with.

hotkeys.label: Keyboard shortcuts
hotkeys.description: The key each command is bound to for everyone on this instance. Each person can rebind a shortcut for their own account in their preferences.

storage.label: Storage
storage.description: How much people may upload: the size of a single file, the attachment types accepted, and the storage each dự án gets.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.description: The bot people connect their Telegram account to, and the one that delivers Telegram thông báo for dự án that set no bot of their own.

email.label: Email provider
email.description: The mail provider the instance sends through: password resets, address confirmation, and sign-in links.

auth-provider.label: Auth provider
auth-provider.description: The external accounts people may đăng nhập with.

scim.label: SCIM
scim.description: Let an identity provider tạo, cập nhật and deactivate accounts on this instance, and grant dự án access through its groups.

general.label: Chung
general.description: The dự án's name, mô tả, and the sections it shows.

states.label: States
states.description: The workflow states issues move through, each shown as a column.

issue-types.label: Issue types
issue-types.description: The kinds of issues this dự án can hold, each with its own fields.

labels.label: Nhãn
labels.description: Tags for organizing and filtering issues across the dự án.

custom-fields.label: Custom fields
custom-fields.description: Extra fields shown on issues, global or scoped to an issue type.

issue-templates.label: Issue templates
issue-templates.description: Presets a new issue can be created from: its title, mô tả, and properties.

configuration.label: Configuration
configuration.description: How subtasks đóng with their parent, and when stale issues are archived.

actions.label: Actions
actions.description: Buttons on an issue that set fields in one click.

schedules.label: Schedules
schedules.description: Run agent tasks on a recurring schedule.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Send dự án events to external URLs, signed with a per-webhook secret.

git.label: Repositories
git.description: Đóng issues when their pull requests merge on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, or Bitbucket.

import-export.label: Import/Export
import-export.description: Bring issues, bình luận, and labels in from a self-hosted Plane instance, or export this dự án's data as JSON.

ai-agents.label: AI Agents
ai-agents.description: AI agents working in this dự án.
